notes.description: A golden pistol with a single round that kills whatever it hits. Miss, and you're holding jewellery.
notes.model: The owner's own Gold Walther PPK (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json): one shot, one kill. Sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the Meshy community gilded flintlock pistol. The flat-colour kit pistol is the fallback.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 2: sidearms.
